analysis: Validation-only ensemble diagnostic for variance versus shared bias
excluded: all test split files and predictions
c64G1 because no saved validation array exists
alignment: Require exact equality across candidates for molecule IDs, source row indices, matrix-order state slots, raw f_true, and f_true mask before any score is computed.
fixed_ensembles: all three candidates at equal 1/3 weights
each of the three pairs at equal 1/2 weights
fitted_ensemble: Minimize masked raw oscillator-strength SSE with nonnegative sum-to-one weights using deterministic SLSQP; fit on four of five molecule-level folds, predict the held-out fold, repeat all folds.
fold_rule: fold = integer(SHA256(UTF8(str(molecule ID)))) mod 5; all states for one molecule stay together.
metrics: bright-transition SSE for raw f_true at or above the whole-validation 90th percentile
interpretation: OOF weights assess blend fitting conditional on the saved validation predictions; base checkpoint selection already used validation. Results are exploratory and do not replace an untouched test, which is forbidden for this diagnostic.
